details: Dendreo 1.1.3 and 1.1.4 were published on 2026-07-18 from the gem's long-dormant maintainer account (previous release 1.1.2, 2020-10-24) and add the malicious git_credential_manager gem as a dependency (SleeperGem campaign). The loader exits if any of about 30 CI environment variables is set; otherwise it downloads a second stage from https://git.disroot.org/git-ecosystem/ (an account on a public Forgejo instance) with TLS verification disabled and runs it. The second stage installs a daemon at $HOME/.local/share/gcm/git-credential-manager with systemd user service and cron persistence, probes sudo/wheel membership, and when run as root drops a setuid-root shell at /usr/local/sbin/ping6. Reported by Aikido Security and analyzed by StepSecurity. Only 1.1.3 and 1.1.4 are affected; both were yanked, and 1.1.2 and earlier are the legitimate releases.

files.note: daemon and its config dropped by the second stage
